Corporate Profits Soar While Factory Jobs Lag, Data Shows

Corporate profits in India have seen a significant surge of 88% over a four-year period, while factory employment has grown at a slower rate of 31% during the same timeframe. This disparity raises questions about the drivers of economic growth and income distribution. One analysis suggests that mass incomes require growth in small businesses, not solely relying on corporate sector job creation.
